alert_summary: Anonymous risk assessment: 3 concern(s) identified at severity 7/10. Board verdict: MODERATE RISK — IRM Board finds manageable concerns. Monitor closely.. Recommend board review.
concerns: DANGEROUS DIVERGENCE: Market appears complacent (VIX est. ~12) while IRM-rated portfolio risk is HIGH. Shiller: complacency at fundamental highs is a classic late-cycle signal. Soros reflexivity: prices can remain irrational while risk accumulates silently.

FACTOR CONCENTRATION — Tech/Growth: 42% of R&D picks. Fama-French: factor tilts amplify both upside AND downside. In a rate-shock (2022 analogue), tech-heavy portfolios experienced -35% to -70% drawdowns. Recommend capping tech at 40.0%.

CREDIT SPREAD RISK in high-risk regime: when equity markets sell off, credit spreads typically widen simultaneously, reducing cross-asset diversification. Equity-only portfolios lose their correlation buffer precisely when it is most needed (Ilmanen, 'Expected Returns').
findings: Historical stress scenario [EXTREME] — 'Global Financial Crisis (2008-09)': estimated loss -68.2% (≈$-66,556) if a comparable event occurred today. Lesson: Correlations go to 1 in a crash. Diversification fails precisely when you need it most. Liquidity evaporates. Stop-losses may gap through levels in a fast market.
